docs.title: Documentation Hub
docs.text: Welcome! This repository hosts documentation for several topics. Each topic is its own MkDocs project, built and published together under one site.

docs.title: Topics
docs.text: Topic Description BCGeo Docs Tech notes for the Benin Climate Geoportal (BCGeo) — GeoNode customizations, production ops, SSO, backups and more. Password protected. STAC Browser Research & development notes for the STAC Browser. SDI(s) Notes on serverless and traditional server-based geospatial data infrastructures

docs.title: Running locally
docs.text:
python -m venv .docs_venv && source .docs_venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
export PASSWORD=your_password   # required by the BCGeo topic
./scripts/build.sh              # build every site into ./site

See the README for serving a single topic.
